description: This file manages session persistence, including initializing Redis and database session stores, and provides functions to destroy user sessions across different storage backends.

methods.name: initializeRedisClientAndStore
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Redis session store, creating a Redis client if necessary.

methods.name: initializeDBClientAndStore
methods.description: Initializes and returns a database session store based on environment configuration (sqlite, mysql, postgres).

methods.name: getUserIdFromSession
methods.description: Extracts user ID from a session object or JSON string.

methods.name: destroyAllSessionsForUser
methods.description: Deletes all sessions associated with a specific user ID from Redis or database store.
